publication_safety.privacy_opinion: Public text stays inside coarse virtual-basis percentage bands, empty positions, and disposition labels. No reconstructable quantities, limit prices, balances, account identifiers, or dollar PnL appear.
publication_safety.statistical_opinion: Denominators are honest: zero fills, WMT as pre-trigger failure only, sector-pair marks descriptive and correlated, empty observation store not dressed up as zero edge, and earlier basis epochs kept unpooled. No counterfactual fills or plumbing-as-alpha claims.

strategy_critique.opinion: The binding call is correct: halt aggressive issuance until one sanctioned treatment/control pair round-trips into a nonempty learning report. The book being flat is integrity, not alpha. Strategy stack is still mostly one reclaim family plus an under-controlled pair cohort and unmeasured registry ideas; engineering the evidence machine beats inventing new setups.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: Pooled level and VWAP reclaim variants share the same breakout/reclaim microstructure and same-session clustering risk. Sector-pair reversion is only partly distinct and currently one correlated two-leg cohort. Overnight/intraday decomposition, quality MR, and gap-fill MR are adjacent mean-reversion/timing ideas until each has its own frozen control and sample.
missed_alternatives: Single-name event-void control: compare post-catalyst drift only on names with a frozen no-news matched twin rather than another VWAP variant.
Time-of-day participation audit: MEASUREMENT_ONLY fill-quality and spread/slippage buckets by session segment before any reclaim family is rescoring.

current_strategy_grades.name: Prospective treatment/control persistence
current_strategy_grades.reason: Sole honest activation gate while the production observation store and family report are empty.

current_strategy_grades.name: Pooled level and VWAP reclaim
current_strategy_grades.reason: Correctly halted; WMT is discipline evidence only. Keep immutable artifacts as PAPER shadow, do not retune from empty ledgers.

current_strategy_grades.name: Sector-pair relative-value reversion
current_strategy_grades.reason: Carry the open cohort to horizon as descriptive only; next cohort needs leader-leg, cash control, units, concentration, and catalyst exclusions frozen at registration.

current_strategy_grades.name: Overnight and intraday decomposition
current_strategy_grades.reason: Right use is writer/control-path proof from abundant completed-session index bars, not an order signal.

current_strategy_grades.name: Quality mean reversion and gap-fill reversion
current_strategy_grades.reason: Correctly unstarted until each has bytes-frozen definition, matched control, causal fills, sample, success/kill rules, and working persistence.

bounded_recommendations.name: Sanctified treatment/control round-trip probe
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: One pre-registered micro treatment identity plus matched control with identical timestamps, return units, causal resolution rules, and persistence keys; no bracket or order path.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Matched control written in the same transaction as treatment; empty-store baseline is failure, not zero edge.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: 1 full sanctioned pair that lands as durable nonempty rows in the production observation store and appears in a freshly generated family report.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Only unlocks further MEASUREMENT_ONLY scoring claims after exact identity round-trip and nonempty report checksum; never unlocks sizing or executable brackets.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Kill if identity mutates, rows fail to persist, report stays empty, or any path attempts order authority.

bounded_recommendations.name: Sector-pair next-cohort control freeze
bounded_recommendations.frozen_setup: Before any new pair cohort: freeze treatment leg, leader-leg control, cash control, registration timestamps, return units, concentration caps, and catalyst exclusions in one immutable artifact; current cohort remains descriptive-only to horizon.
bounded_recommendations.benchmark_or_control: Leader-leg and cash controls registered with the treatment; no expectancy from the live under-controlled cohort.
bounded_recommendations.minimum_sample: At least 30 independent pair cohorts under the frozen package, after the current cohort expires without promotion credit.
bounded_recommendations.promotion_rule: Shadow expectancy may be discussed only after minimum sample with stable sign vs both controls and documented non-concentration; still no executable promotion from this entry.
bounded_recommendations.kill_rule: Kill/re-register if any control was missing at start, legs collapse to one factor bet, catalyst exclusion fails, or marks are used for sizing.

disagreements_to_preserve: I would keep quality MR and gap-fill fully dark until the evidence machine works; no pressure to register them this week even as shadows.
Sector-pair could be retired rather than iterated if the next registration still cannot freeze leader and cash controls together—iterate is conditional generosity, not endorsement.

result.summary: PASS both tracks. Privacy and statistical framing are clean; strategy posture correctly freezes issuance on an empty learning ledger. Grades favor keeping the measurement gate and overnight infrastructure, shadowing reclaim and unstarted MR families, and iterating sector-pair only with real controls. Two bounded measurement/shadow experiments proposed; no hard-gate loosening and no order authority.
